snippet.title: Giant's Steps 💾 Retro Roguelike 💾 Wishlist on Steam!
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4861760/Giants_Steps/

Giant's Steps is an upcoming retro style roguelike RPG, using a proprietary vector-renderer technology to transport you into the radical futuristic-past of 80s gaming!

☣️Lead scavengers of this post-apocalyptic fantasy world on their ill-fated journeys into an ancient techno-magic facility. 
Delve deep and face the challenges and abominations infesting this forgotten husk!
☣️Peer into the void and gain insight into this broken world, the vault and its terrifying residents!
☣️Use simple but highly customisable RPG systems and randomly generated artefacts to craft unique scavenger builds... and lead them to their inevitable doom!
